name: Alsfeld (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red in the proportions 1:7:1, charged above the centre with the city arms of Alsfeld (a red lion on white with helmet and crest).
history: The banner is red-white-red striped in the proportions 1:7:1 with the arms above the centre.

features.role: Alsfeld arms — red lion with crest
